name: Pull-down drying rack
description: Wall/cabinet-mounted fold-down clothes drying rack (aluminium rods in a frame, hinged along the bottom edge, two side chains). Folded it lies flat against the panel; pulled down it sticks out horizontally to hang clothes on. Typical sizes 60-80 wide, 40-60 out (e.g. the common Brabantia / IKEA-style pull-down airers); generic planning model. Double-click to pull down / fold up (the whole rack, chains included).
